# Zkt Timer

> Zkt Timer (also written ZKT Timer) is a speedcubing timer and training platform for the Rubik's Cube and the other WCA puzzles, on the web (https://zktimer.app), iOS and Android. It times solves with official WCA scrambles, keeps statistics, and has an algorithm trainer for OLL, PLL, F2L, ZBLL and more, smart cube support, live race rooms, 1v1 battle and WCA competition tracking. It is made by İbrahim Yıldız (ibrhyyme, https://zktimer.app/user/ibrhyyme), its founder and developer and the software development lead of Zeka Küpü Türkiye. Available in Turkish, English, Spanish, Russian and Chinese.

## How Zkt Timer helps a cuber get faster

- **Timed practice**: every solve gets an official WCA scramble, with WCA inspection, +2 and DNF penalties, and averages (ao5, ao12, ao100 and longer) per session and per puzzle.
- **Learning algorithms**: the [Trainer](https://zktimer.app/trainer) drills 43 algorithm categories, among them OLL, PLL, F2L and ZBLL, times each case separately and shows which ones are slowest. Algorithm sets can be built, shared and taken from the [Community Sets](https://zktimer.app/trainer/community).
- **Recognition and efficiency**: a PLL recognition trainer for reading cases faster, and a cross efficiency trainer for planning the cross in fewer moves.
- **Smart cubes**: Bluetooth smart cubes (GAN, Giiker, MoYu, QiYi and others) record every move, so a solve is split into its phases (cross, F2L, OLL, PLL) and the slow step is visible.
- **Statistics**: personal bests, averages over time and graphs on the [Stats](https://zktimer.app/stats) page; daily solve goals.
- **Timers and inputs**: keyboard, touch, StackMat, GAN Timer and QiYi Timer; in the mobile app (Pro), a magnetic cube can start the timer when lifted and stop it when set down.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://zktimer.app/): overview of the features
- [Timer](https://zktimer.app/timer): the cube timer, usable without an account
- [Trainer](https://zktimer.app/trainer): algorithm, PLL recognition and cross trainers
- [Algorithms](https://zktimer.app/trainer/algorithms): every algorithm category
- [Live Rooms](https://zktimer.app/rooms): real-time race rooms with chat
- [Battle](https://zktimer.app/battle): 1v1 for two players on one device (phone, tablet or desktop), with regular or smart cubes
<!-- launch:online_battle -->
- [Online Battle leaderboard](https://zktimer.app/ranks): ratings from rated 1v1 Online Battle matches, played with smart cubes against whoever is searching at that moment
<!-- /launch:online_battle -->
- [WCA Competitions](https://zktimer.app/competitions): WCA competitions worldwide, with schedules, groups and live results
- [Help](https://zktimer.app/help): guides and frequently asked questions
- [Pro](https://zktimer.app/pro): Pro membership and its extra features
- [Sign Up](https://zktimer.app/signup): create an account

## Türkçe özet

Zkt Timer, zeka küpü (Rubik küpü) için süre tutucu ve antrenman platformudur; web, iOS ve Android'de çalışır. WCA standardında karıştırmalarla süre tutar, ortalamaları ve istatistikleri takip eder. Trainer bölümünde OLL, PLL, F2L ve ZBLL algoritmaları çalışılır, PLL tanıma ve cross verimliliği antrenmanı yapılır. Smart küplerle çözüm cross, F2L, OLL ve PLL adımlarına ayrılır. Zkt Timer'ı Zeka Küpü Türkiye'nin yazılım geliştirme sorumlusu İbrahim Yıldız (ibrhyyme) geliştirdi. Türkçe sayfalar ?lang=tr adresindedir, örnek: https://zktimer.app/trainer?lang=tr

## Translations

Every page has a URL per language: the bare URL is English, `?lang=tr`, `?lang=es`, `?lang=ru` and `?lang=zh` are the translations (for the home page: https://zktimer.app/welcome?lang=tr).

## Platforms

- Web: https://zktimer.app (installable as a PWA, works offline)
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/zkt-timer/id6760920873
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zktimer.app

## Related

- Zeka Küpü Türkiye (https://zekakuputurkiye.com): the Turkish speedcubing community that organizes ZKT competitions. Zkt Timer shows their schedules, groups, staff assignments and live results.
- Sitemap: https://zktimer.app/sitemap.xml
